title: Valor, Atreides, and Sequoia back AI startup Flow Engineering at $750M valuation
slides: Why does a $750M bet on Flow Engineering matter?
Valor, Atreides, and Sequoia led the round.
The startup has almost no public product traction yet.
Your AI engineering tools may soon face a cheaper rival.
Watch which investors follow this pattern next quarter.
thread_text:
1. The $750M Question

Valor, Atreides, and Sequoia just co-led a massive round for Flow Engineering. That's a lot of money for a company with no public product.

2. No Product Yet

The startup has almost no public traction. Investors are betting on a thesis, not a shipped tool.

3. Your Tools Just Got Target

If Flow Engineering succeeds, your current AI engineering stack could face a cheaper rival overnight.

4. Follow the Money

Sequoia and Valor have a pattern of backing pre-product bets. Watch which investors copy this move next quarter.

5. Test This Yourself

Take your current AI tooling and ask: what would a $750M competitor do differently? If you can't answer, start there.
